purpose.buyer: Owner or manager of a small business whose site looks outdated or hides the offer.
purpose.problem: Buyers bounce before they ever reach a usable enquiry path.
purpose.outcome: A credible, mobile-ready landing with one clear next step — not a months-long rebuild.
purpose.buyer_action: Request discovery on the named Website Rescue landing.

pronunciation.say: corpflow A I dot com slash website-rescue

script.full_text: When a website looks outdated or hides the offer, buyers leave before they ever reach you. Website Rescue turns a weak landing page into a credible enquiry path — fast. One named offer. One primary action: Request discovery. Starting from forty-five thousand Mauritian rupees after we confirm scope. You receive a mobile-ready landing with Hook, Proof and Depth, a working enquiry path, and a preview before any production release — not a months-long rebuild. You are not expected to write a technical specification. We guide the design from a plain-language brief. Discovery comes first. Then a written quote. A fifty percent Mauritian rupee deposit by manual bank transfer. First visible preview within twenty-four to seventy-two hours after deposit and assets. We do not guarantee new revenue. We help make the offer clear and the enquiry path usable. Request discovery at corpflowai.com/website-rescue.
disclosures: We do not guarantee new revenue.
